description:
**Divergence** — 3 cookie-cutter regressions in tasks-server's MemoryError plus 1 in metadata-server's Display impl:

| Axis | mail-server (canonical) | tasks-server | metadata-server |
|---|---|---|---|
| `#[non_exhaustive]` | yes | NO (src/memory.rs:88-91) | yes |
| inner field name | `description` | `msg` (src/memory.rs:90) | `description` |
| read accessor | `description()` | `message()` (src/memory.rs:100) | `description()` |
| Display impl prefix | `"MemoryBackend error: {description}"` | NO prefix (src/memory.rs:105-109) | NO prefix (src/memory.rs:649-653) |

The 5 other extension-server siblings (chat, calendars, contacts, filenode, sharing) match the canonical mail-server shape byte-identical, with a rustdoc line "Mirrors the canonical jmap-mail-server MemoryError shape" referencing the canonical-template propagation rule.

**Caller-observable / maintainer cost**:
- A SemVer-major in tasks-server would be required if tasks-server ever needs to add a `kind`/`source` field to its MemoryError, where the same change in any of the other 7 siblings would be a non-breaking minor (because of `#[non_exhaustive]`).
- Cross-crate code that wants to extract diagnostic text from a MemoryError (e.g. shared test helpers) cannot use the same accessor name on tasks-server's variant.
- Log scraping / observability tooling that filters on `"MemoryBackend error:"` silently misses metadata-server and tasks-server failures.

**Fix sequence**:
(a) tasks-server src/memory.rs:88-91: add `#[non_exhaustive]`, rename `msg` to `description`, rename `message()` to `description()`, add `"MemoryBackend error: "` prefix to Display impl. Add a rustdoc line matching the 5 siblings.
(b) metadata-server src/memory.rs:649-653: add `"MemoryBackend error: "` prefix to Display impl.

Two-file mechanical sweep. cargo test --workspace verifies no caller breakage (no current caller depends on the divergent shapes).
title: tasks-server's MemoryError diverges from canonical mail-server's MemoryError on three axes; metadata-server's Display impl drops the canonical 'MemoryBackend error:' prefix
